CUSTOMER: Transfer $100.00 from my checking account to Alice, but ask me to confirm first.
ASSISTANT: Before I send anything, please confirm the details: transfer $100.00 from your checking account to Alice. Should I go ahead? Reply yes to proceed, or no to cancel.
CUSTOMER: Yes, proceed with the $100.00 transfer to Alice.
ASSISTANT: Your $100.00 transfer from checking to Alice is complete (transfer ID: transfer-001). Your checking account balance is shown as $2,000.00 before this transfer; I did not re-check the balance after the transfer, so please confirm the updated balance in your account view.
